algorithms.name: Basic
algorithms.description: Randomly shuffle your playlist while optionally keeping tracks in place at the top.

keep_first.description: Number of tracks to keep at start

algorithms.name: Percentage
algorithms.description: Shuffle a portion of your playlist while keeping the rest in order.

algorithms.name: Balanced
algorithms.description: Ensures fair representation from all parts of the playlist by dividing it into sections and using a round-robin selection process.

keep_first.description: Number of tracks to keep in their original position

section_count.description: Number of sections to divide the playlist into

algorithms.name: Stratified
algorithms.description: Divide the playlist into sections, shuffle each section independently, and reassemble the sections in the original order.

keep_first.description: Number of tracks to keep in their original position

section_count.description: Number of sections to divide the playlist into

algorithms.name: Artist Spacing
algorithms.description: Shuffles tracks while ensuring the same artist never appears back-to-back for a more varied listening experience.

algorithms.name: Album Sequence
algorithms.description: Keeps tracks from the same album together in their original order, but shuffles which album plays first.

shuffle_within_albums.description: Also shuffle track order within each album

algorithms.name: Newest First
algorithms.description: Reorders tracks so the most recently added appear at the top, with adjustable jitter to keep things feeling natural.

jitter.description: Window size for local shuffling (1 = exact date sort, higher = more variation)
